title: AgentCard
description: A machine-readable declaration of an AI agent, runner, or worker's capabilities. Used by Runners for selection and by Adapters for host-surface mapping. The capabilities structure is an array of typed capability objects. runner_type uses a controlled vocabulary with extension support via 'custom:' prefix.

type.description: Agent type classification. Core types: 'worker', 'runner', 'service', 'adapter', 'coordinator'. Extensible — consumers must handle unknown types.

capabilities.description: List of declared capabilities. Each capability is a typed object with a name and optional parameters.

description.description: Optional description of what this capability provides.

parameters.description: Optional key-value parameters for the capability (e.g., languages, frameworks, tools).

runner_type.description: Type of runner this agent uses. Core values: 'claude-code', 'codex', 'openclaw', 'hermes', 'generic'. Extensible via 'custom:' prefix (e.g., 'custom:my-runner').

version.description: Version of the agent declaration itself, following semver.

description.description: Human-readable description of the agent's role and purpose.

supported_protocol_version.description: The exact IEF Protocol version this AgentCard conforms to. For this schema version, the value must be '0.1.0'.
